summary: Frontend-only verification of the remark-gfm build fix. Confirmed webpack compiles with no 'Module not found / Can't resolve remark-gfm' error (only a pre-existing eslint exhaustive-deps warning in PriceChart.jsx). Dev server serves valid app HTML (HTTP 200, no webpack error overlay). Verified AssistantPanel imports react-markdown + remark-gfm and renders markdown at runtime: a prompted answer produced a real HTML <table> (1 table, 2 th, 6 td), <del> strikethrough, <ul>/<li>, <h2> and 11 <strong> — no literal '##' or '**' leaked into the rendered text. Streaming via /api/assistant/ask worked end-to-end twice (typed question ~12s, suggested question 3913 chars), tokens arrived progressively, no error banner, zero console errors. Regression sweep: all 9 routes loaded and all 8 company tabs rendered cleanly.

issues: GFM tables render but are unstyled/borderless with very tight cell text in the 460px panel; consider prose table styling (borders, cell padding, overflow-x-auto) so wide tables don't cramp

action_items: None blocking. Optional: add table/th/td styling (or Tailwind typography prose classes) to .assistant-stream so GFM tables are readable in the narrow panel.
Optional data-quality note: the assistant itself flagged that NVDA seed financials are internally inconsistent (revenue $658.8B vs market cap ~$2.2T / P/E 68.4). Consider aligning demo seed data.
critical_code_review_comments: AssistantPanel.jsx lines 1-3 and 145 confirmed correct: remark-gfm imported and passed as remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}. package.json has react-markdown ^10.1.0 and remark-gfm ^4.0.1, and node_modules/remark-gfm is present — the earlier failure was purely a stale webpack cache, now resolved.
Stream error handling appends a '⚠︎' inline message rather than a dedicated error element; acceptable but a data-testid on the error text would improve testability.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing NVDA seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: remark-gfm build error is fully resolved and verified at runtime (GFM table + strikethrough render). Assistant streaming works with Claude Sonnet 5 via /api/assistant/ask; expect ~10-25s per answer, so poll for at least 30s. Useful selectors: [data-testid=ask-analyst], [data-testid=assistant-panel], [data-testid=assistant-input], [data-testid=assistant-send], [data-testid=assistant-stop], [data-testid=assistant-suggestion-0..4], and .assistant-stream for the rendered markdown container. To force GFM output, explicitly ask the model for a markdown table + ~~strikethrough~~. Backend APIs were not re-tested this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was a stale webpack resolution cache in /app/frontend/node_modules/.cache; remark-gfm was already declared and installed. Clearing the cache and restarting the frontend supervisor process fixed it. Confirmed: /var/log/supervisor/frontend.out.log shows 'webpack compiled with 1 warning' and no 'Failed to compile'.
